$description: Color / Active — warning mode. All values alias the 'warning' family from Semantic / Color. Apply this mode to a frame/component to make it warning-colored (caution, approaching limits). Use in Figma by setting the 'Color / Active' collection mode to 'warning'.

color.$description: Primary accent fill for warning components

on-color.$description: Text/icon color drawn on top of 'color'

container.$description: Subtle tinted background for warning-colored containers

focus.$description: Focus ring color (semi-transparent) for warning-colored components
